SELECT
    `orders___region`,
    `orders___band`,
    `orders___ordered_at`,
    `orders___m`,
    `orders___c`
FROM (
WITH _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_city AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner.`orders___city` AS `city`,
    _stage_inner.`orders___amount_sum_partition_by_city` AS `amount_sum_partition_by_city`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.city AS `orders___city`,
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___amount_sum_partition_by_city`
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      orders.city
  ) AS _stage_inner
), base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.region AS `orders___region`,
    CASE
      WHEN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_city.`amount_sum_partition_by_city` > 35
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS `orders___band`,
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `orders___ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___m`
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_city
    ON orders.city IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_city.`city`
  GROUP BY
    orders.region,
    CASE
      WHEN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_city.`amount_sum_partition_by_city` > 35
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END,
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___region`,
    `orders___band`,
    `orders___ordered_at`,
    `orders___m`,
    SUM(`orders___m`) OVER (PARTITION BY `orders___region`, `orders___band` ORDER BY `orders___ordered_at`) AS `orders___c`
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  `orders___region`,
  `orders___band`,
  `orders___ordered_at`,
  `orders___m`,
  `orders___c`
FROM step1
) AS _outer
